Demonstration of steps taken to address offending
behaviour
* Previous good character/exemplary conduct is different from having no
previous convictions. The more serious the offence, the less the weight
which should normally be attributed to this factor. Where previous good
character/exemplary conduct has been used to facilitate the offence,
this mitigation should not normally be allowed and such conduct may
constitute an aggravating factor.
